criteria.title: Problem definition
criteria.description: The engineering problem is real, specific and bounded. The ML task is correctly derived from it. The target variable is justified, not merely available.

criteria.title: Data understanding
criteria.description: Provenance, licence and collection method stated. Defects found and handled with justification. Limitations of the data acknowledged before any modelling.

criteria.title: Methodology
criteria.description: Appropriate models chosen and compared under one protocol. Pipeline used. Hyperparameters handled sensibly. Choices explained rather than defaulted to.

criteria.title: Engineering reasoning
criteria.description: Domain knowledge visibly enters the work through features, banding, metric choice or interpretation. The result is discussed as engineering, not as a score.

criteria.title: Validation
criteria.description: Correct train/test discipline, cross-validation with a reported spread, leakage explicitly checked and ruled out, metric justified against the cost of error.

criteria.title: Communication
criteria.description: The 2-page brief is readable by a non-specialist engineer. Charts answer questions and are captioned with findings. Uncertainty and limitations stated honestly.

criteria.title: Reproducibility & documentation
criteria.description: Repository runs from a clean clone. README complete. requirements.txt present. Seeds set. AI use declared. Contribution log present.
